mapper.select: SELECT ib.pid AS 批次ID, ib.type AS 单据类型, ib.direction AS 操作方向, CASE ib.direction WHEN 0 THEN '出库' WHEN 1 THEN '入库' END AS 操作方向描述, ib.nums AS 操作数量, ir.time AS 操作时间, ir.info AS 操作类型, -- 修正单据编号查询逻辑 CASE ib.type WHEN 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_entry WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_extry WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sell WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_buy WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sre WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_bre WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN 'swap' THEN ( SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = ib.class ) END AS 单据编号, -- 调拨方向详细信息 CASE WHEN ib.type = 'swap' AND ib.direction = 0 THEN (SELECT CONCAT('从仓库ID:', warehouse, ' 调出') FROM is_swap_info WHERE id = ib.info) WHEN ib.type = 'swap' AND ib.direction = 1 THEN (SELECT CONCAT('调入仓库ID:', storehouse) FROM is_swap_info WHERE id = ib.info) ELSE '' END AS 调拨详情 FROM is_batch_info ib LEFT JOIN is_record ir ON ib.type = ir.type AND ib.class = ir.source WHERE ib.pid = 1; -- 这里替换为要查询的批次ID
